name: Nova Jupyter Bridge
description: Privacy-focused Jupyter integration for Nova. Open custom Notebook Studio or official JupyterLab in your default browser or Nova Preview. Features include per-cell Python execution and debugging, breakpoints, debugger controls, local MySQL SQL cells, kernel management, and standard Jupyter notebook support.

configWorkspace.title: Python executable
configWorkspace.description: Python executable used by Notebook Studio and JupyterLab. Select an existing Python environment containing jupyter_client, ipykernel, and JupyterLab. You may specify its full executable path. No additional Python environment is created.

configWorkspace.title: Notebook Studio kernel override
configWorkspace.description: Optional kernel override for Notebook Studio. Leave empty to use the notebook's kernel. For Python debugging, select a kernel supporting the Jupyter debugger protocol.

configWorkspace.title: Attempt automatic Nova Preview navigation
configWorkspace.description: When Open in Nova Preview is selected, attempt to navigate Nova Preview automatically using macOS System Events and Accessibility automation. If automatic navigation fails, the private local URL is copied and manual instructions are displayed. The separate Open in Browser option uses the default browser.
